notes.title: The patch is live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The patch is now live and here's what's been fixed or modified:


    V-Sync now enabled,
    On co-op mode, teleportation is no longer automatic. Now you can decide when to teleport yourself,
    The controls can now be remapped using all keyboard keys (except Esc) -	Note : Controller buttons cannot be remapped; only keyboard buttons,
     Mouse support in the menus,
    Performances enhanced.


Have a great Friday!

notes.title: TNI Patch note
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We really appreciate that you take a moment to tell us what you like or not; the issue with the controllers came quite often, so we decided to modify them. Here are the main points we're working on:


Remapping the controls
- The controls can now be remapped using all keyboard keys (except Esc) and mouse buttons!
- Note : Controller buttons cannot be remapped; only keyboard/mouse buttons.

Mouse support in menus
- Player scan now use the mouse to navigate the menus! As mentioned above, gameplay actions can now be assigned to the mouse.

Input selection screen
- The menu structure will undergo some minor changes. This screen appears once a game mode has been selected (‘Single-Player’ or ‘Multiplayer’). There, each player can select an input device (controller/keyboard). For instance, if I have two controllers and one keyboard, I can assign a controller to Player 1 and the keyboard to Player 2 by pressing the appropriate button (e.g. ‘Press A to join’).
- Note : We are considering removing the ‘Single-Player’ and ‘Multiplayer’ buttons from the main menu and replacing them with a ‘Play’ button, as the input selection screen renders them obsolete.

I'll keep you updated when they'e all effective!

Have a great week
